falsePositiveClaims: TEST_COMPLETE is a literal on all ten module objects.
INTEGRATION_COMPLETE is awarded when journey.steps are ok, including steps whose ok flag is a literal.
SECURITY_VERIFIED is a literal on core and security after three checks.
PERFORMANCE_TESTED is a literal on core. The timer covers snapshot search and one fixture quote.
Customer, notification, returns, and order-created flags are object literals.
openedDevDb and egressDefault in the contract report are literals. The file-descriptor check and the policy file are the separate evidence.
inventedCatalogPrice is a literal false. The same function then prices a 20 EUR fixture.
buyStock always returns HUMAN_GATE_REQUIRED and does not consult the approval center.
crashIsolation throws and catches Error in the same function, then calls dispatch again.
assessVoice sets webrtcCode true without creating a signaling room. signaling.js is not loaded.
Live operations receives INTEGRATION_COMPLETE and TEST_COMPLETE from constants.
evaluateOffer.salesEnabled is a constant false, separate from isSalesEnabled().
